description: Client-side script managing project display slider, filtering, and dynamic loading in a web page.

methods.name: setSlideVisibility
methods.description: Adjusts opacity of visible slides and hides partial slides for smooth carousel display.

methods.name: destroySlickProjects
methods.description: Destroys the slick carousel instance, ignoring errors if already destroyed.

methods.name: initSlickProjects
methods.description: Initializes the slick carousel with specific settings and handles dynamic loading of slides.

methods.name: drawProjects
methods.description: Fetches and displays projects based on filters and location, reinitializing the slider.
